assessment: This study presents valuable findings on the mechanism of glucocorticoid-induced osteonecrosis of the femoral head. The data were collected and analyzed using solid, validated methodology and can be used as a starting point for functional studies of development of glucocorticoid-induced osteonecrosis. This article would be of interest to cell biologists and biophysicists working on potential pharmacological treatments for glucocorticoid-induced osteonecrosis.
